# DistrViz

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Airpino/DistrViz/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Airpino/DistrViz/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

**DistrViz** draws distributional data tables, where each cell is a whole
distribution: matrices of histograms (`MatH` objects of
[HistDAWass](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=HistDAWass)), matrices of
discrete distributions (`MatD` objects of
[DDAWASS](https://github.com/Airpino/DDAWASS)), or raw and tabulated discrete
data (e.g. ratings on a Likert scale).

* **Green Eyes plots** (`gei_plot()`, `gei_grid()`): a circular display of all
  the distributions observed on a unit (Crocetta, Irpino, Antonucci and Marin,
  2025, [doi:10.1007/s11135-024-01956-0](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11135-024-01956-0)).
* **Green Eyes on a factorial plane** (`gei_pca()`): the eyes placed at the
  positions of the units on a quantile PCA/MFA, with a key eye (the barycenter
  of all the units or of each group); an interactive version (**ggiraph**)
  has tooltips, hides eyes with a click or a lasso, zooms, and has switches
  and a size slider.
* **Flower plots** (`flower_plot()`, `flower_grid()`): each variable is a stem
  with petals at its values, as wide as their probabilities.
* **Difference eyes** (`gei_diff()`): where the distributions of each unit
  depart from the barycenter (or from a reference unit or group).
* **Ordering of the sectors** by the shortest Hamiltonian cycle through the
  variables (`var_order = "tsp"`, `dv_var_order()`).
* **Distributional heatmaps** (`dist_heatmap()`): each cell is a stacked bar of
  the distribution; rows and columns are ordered by Wasserstein-based
  hierarchical clustering, with dendrograms. Interactive version with
  **plotly**.

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Airpino/DDAWASS")
remotes::install_github("Airpino/DistrViz")
```

## Example

```{r example, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4}
library(DistrViz)
dv <- dv_data(DDAWASS::Satisfaction, ranges = c(0, 10))
gei_grid(dv, rows = 1:8, ncol = 4)
```

```{r pca, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5}
gei_pca(dv, var_order = "tsp")
```

```{r heatmap, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6}
dist_heatmap(dv)
```

See the vignettes for the details: `browseVignettes("DistrViz")`.
